lines.zh: 我抱着头骨，贴着墙根走。
lines.en: I hug the skull and creep along the wall.
Blackstone burns my feet, so I walk fast.

lines.zh: 前面有光，我绕进阴影里。
lines.en: Light ahead; I slip into the shadows.

lines.zh: 我一步三回头，怕有人跟。
lines.en: I look back every step, fearing a follower.

lines.zh: 骨头顶着沉甸甸的头颅。
lines.en: My frame sags under the heavy skull.

lines.zh: 我踩着煤渣，脚下沙沙响。
lines.en: Coal dust crunches under my feet.
The corridor is long, so I trot.
I hunch my shoulders and stay quiet.

lines.zh: 头骨太重，我走路有点歪。
lines.en: The skull is heavy; I walk crooked.
I follow the lava edge for a darker path.
Footsteps? No, just my joints.
I hide in an abandoned mineshaft.
I wipe ash off the skull.
No one is coming; I relax.

lines.zh: 我把头骨换个姿势抱着。
lines.en: I shift the skull to a better grip.
Coal clinks in my pocket.

lines.zh: 我数着岩浆泡，等时间过去。
lines.en: I count lava bubbles to pass the time.

lines.zh: 一点脚步声就让我僵住。
lines.en: A single footstep freezes me.
I hide the skull behind my back.

lines.zh: 骨头缝里漏出一点黑烟。
lines.en: A wisp of black smoke leaks from my bones.

lines.zh: 我蹲在角落里，尽量变小。
lines.en: I crouch in the corner, trying to shrink.

lines.zh: 这头骨的牙，比我的还白。
lines.en: This skull's teeth are whiter than mine.
Stay back, y-you hear me!

lines.zh: 你看见我抱的东西了吗？
lines.en: Did you see what I am holding?

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，怕你伸手。
lines.en: I watch your hands, afraid you will reach.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就少怕一点。
lines.en: Step back and I fear you a little less.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛太亮了，我不敢看。
lines.en: Your eyes are too bright; I cannot look.
I am only passing through, truly.
Are you here to take the skull?
I clutch the skull tighter.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味，让我腿软。
lines.en: The smell of your iron makes my knees weak.
Do not laugh; I know I am small.
Do not hit me; I took nothing.
The skull nearly slipped away.
One of my ribs just cracked.
It hurts; I back away.
You crushed my coal.

lines.zh: 我蹲下，把头骨护在怀里。
lines.en: I crouch and shield the skull.
Do not touch my neck.
I am light-boned; one push knocks me down.
This wound will take long to mend.
I cannot run now; please.
Is that a wither rose?
Bring the flower and I will not run.
Will you trade the skull for it?
I have coal; trade me one flower.
That black flower smells like safety.

lines.zh: 你放在地上，我自己去拿。
lines.en: Set it down and I will fetch it myself.
Two pieces of coal; is that enough?
The flower for me, the skull for you.

lines.zh: 你手里那朵花，我一直想要。
lines.en: That flower in your hand is all I want.
Do not wave it; I cannot see the petals.
I hug my skull tight; do not take it.
You nearly knocked the skull loose.
I back off; do not touch me.
Your bump made my bones clack.
Holding the skull, I cannot brace myself.
Excuse me; I only want to pass.
Do not crowd me; I am losing my grip.
That bump spilled my coal.
I slid two steps before finding balance.
You are strong; I am scared.
Nobody wants this skull but us, right?
Let us hide it together.
You keep watch; I sleep with the skull.

lines.zh: 两颗小骷髅挤在一起，不冷。
lines.en: Two small skeletons huddle and stay warm.
Your bones are whiter than mine.
Do not grab; we take turns holding it.
If someone comes, you run first.
I saved you a piece of coal.
We hide in the same mineshaft.
Skull in the middle; nobody touches it.
This coal shines; I keep it.
A bone on the floor; that one is mine.
Who dropped this wither rose?
I pick it up and tuck it under my ribs.
One coal; half a flower's worth.
This bone is thicker than my arm.
Don't grab it - this skull is mine.

lines.zh: 我把煤塞满口袋，走路响。
lines.en: Coal fills my pockets and rattles.
The flower wilted, but I still want it.

lines.zh: 捡东西时，我也不敢松手。
lines.en: Even picking things up, I keep one hand on the skull.
Footsteps; I freeze at once.
Someone over there; I clutch the skull.
He saw me; I have to run.
Iron boots are getting closer.

lines.zh: 我不是要打，我只想躲开。
lines.en: I am not fighting; I only want to hide.
That shadow blocks the exit.

lines.zh: 他手里有剑，我腿都软了。
lines.en: He has a sword; my legs go weak.
I look for an escape before I look at him.
Someone is searching my mineshaft.
He is reaching for the skull.
I cannot leave it behind.
No heart to pound, yet I tremble.
Ten steps away; I can still run.

lines.zh: 我盯住那只手，别的不看。
lines.en: I fix on his hand and nothing else.

lines.zh: 你手里没有头骨，我松口气。
lines.en: You hold no skull, so I breathe again.
He goes left; I slip right.
I count the steps to the mineshaft.
He stops, and so do I.
I wait for him to stoop for loot.
Behind that door is a dead end; not there.

lines.zh: 他的视线偏了，就是现在。
lines.en: His gaze slipped; now is my chance.

lines.zh: 我盯着他的靴子，等它转向。
lines.en: I watch his boots for the turn.

lines.zh: 他要是抬手，我立刻蹲下。
lines.en: If he raises a hand, I duck.
The lava side is hot, but it blocks pursuit.

lines.zh: 我留了一条窄缝给自己。
lines.en: I left myself one narrow gap.
He is faster; I must take the long way.
Three, two, one, run.
I shift the skull to my inner arm.
He is watching; I will not look back.
I count how many steps you take.

lines.zh: 你往哪边看，我就往反方向。
lines.en: Whichever way you look, I go the other way.
I press my back to the wall and edge along.
You bend down, and I get ready to run.
Stay back; I bite!
I swing the skull at you.
This punch has little force.
I kick your shin.
Grab it and I bite your fingers.
My skull, don't touch it.
Bone on iron; I am the one hurting.
I throw a lump of coal.
One hit, then I run.

lines.zh: 别逼我，这把小剑也够快。
lines.en: Don't push me; this little sword is quick enough.
Guarding the skull, I swing wildly.
Back off and we are fine.
My teeth are sharper than they look.
This bite is to make myself brave.
I knock your knee with a bone.
Don't grab, I bite gently.
I squeeze out of a blackstone crack.
Nice and dark here; just how I like it.
The skull is in my arms; thank goodness.
First thing I do is find a hiding spot.

lines.zh: 岩浆光晃得我睁不开眼。
lines.en: The lava glow stings my eyes.

lines.zh: 煤渣沾了一身，我拍了拍。
lines.en: Coal dust all over me; I brush it off.
Someone has been in this shaft.
I hear water dripping far away.

lines.zh: 骨头还软，我站了一会儿。
lines.en: My bones still soft, I stand a while.
Who left me in a place like this?
First I settle the skull securely.
These walls cut the wind.

lines.zh: 我缩进阴影，等脚步声过去。
lines.en: I shrink into shadow until the steps pass.
New place; I must learn the paths again.
Flame licks my bones and black smoke rises.

lines.zh: 从矿道摔下去，腿骨断了。
lines.en: I fell down the shaft and broke a leg.
Water makes my bones heavy.
The blast slams me into the wall.
An arrow pins my shoulder blade.
Magic light binds me in place.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只是越来越虚。
lines.en: I eat nothing, yet I weaken.
Lightning hit me; my bones are scorched.

lines.zh: 虚空拽着我的骨头往下沉。
lines.en: The void drags my bones down.
